# M3-10a: Slack Socket Mode core

- Milestone: M3
- Branch / worktree: `t/M3-10a`, `../YNAB_AutoCategorizer.wt/M3-10a`
- Depends on: M3-1c
- Touches (exclusive while running): slack/, go.mod (slack-go only)
- Plan refs: §5, spikes/slack.md §Findings, §Recommendation, N7, N9
- YNAB access: none
- Deploy: no (smoke: none; ships in M3-17)

## Goal
A `slack/` client that connects by Socket Mode, filters and authorizes traffic, and hands clean events to handlers. The existing `status/` client stays as it is.

## Scope
- Add `github.com/slack-go/slack` v0.32.0 to the root module (Go 1.26 verified at M3-plan). Behind interfaces with fakes.
- Ack every envelope first, then handle asynchronously.
- Drop messages with `bot_id` set, and any `subtype` other than none or `thread_broadcast`.
- Authorize: only Slack user ids in `users` are acted on, and only in the configured channel. The workspace has other members, so an unknown clicker gets no effect and no reply.
- Idempotency via `slack_events`: `event_id` for events, `container.message_ts` + `action_ts` for clicks.
- Startup self-check: the channel resolves through `users.conversations`; failure is returned for the caller to alert on.
- Helpers `Post` and `Update`. A handler panic can't kill the socket loop.
- Tokens and ids are never logged.

## Out of scope
- Question rendering (M3-10b), `serve` wiring (M3-14a), DMs, free text to the LLM (M5).

## Acceptance (each must be demonstrably checked)
- [ ] Test: ack happens before a handler that blocks.
- [ ] Table test: bot message, edited-message subtype, unknown user and wrong channel are dropped; `thread_broadcast` passes.
- [ ] Test: a redelivered event runs its handler once, including after reopening the DB.
- [ ] Test: self-check fails when the channel isn't listed.
- [ ] Test: a panicking handler doesn't stop later events.
- [ ] go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... green

## Result
- Status: DONE
- What changed:
  - `slack/slack.go`: new package. `API`, `Socket` and `Store` interfaces (slack-go `*slack.Client`, a
    `socketmode.Client` adapter, `*store.DB`). `New` / `NewFromTokens` (checks the `xapp-` and `xoxb-` prefixes and a
    non-empty channel, and never echoes the values).
  - `Run` acks each envelope in the event loop, then runs the handler on its own goroutine (at most 16 at once, with
    panic recovery). On ctx cancel it waits for handlers and returns nil. It runs `SelfCheck` first if the channel isn't
    resolved yet.
  - Filtering: drops `bot_id` and any subtype except none or `thread_broadcast`. Acts only on users found by
    `UserBySlackID` in the resolved channel; anyone else gets no effect and no reply. Dedupe keys are
    `event:<event_id>` and `click:<container.message_ts>:<action_ts>` via `SeenSlackEvent`, checked after
    filtering/auth and right before the handler. A store error drops the event (at-most-once).
  - Clean `Message` / `Click` types carry the `store.User`. `SelfCheck` pages through
    `users.conversations?types=private_channel` and matches on name (`#` optional) or id; otherwise it returns
    `ErrChannelNotFound`. `Post` / `Update` go to the resolved channel; `ChannelID()` gives callers the id for `questions`.
  - Logs carry only the event type, drop reason and state; errors are scrubbed of both tokens and the channel id; a
    panic's value isn't logged (only the stack).
  - `go.mod`: `github.com/slack-go/slack v0.32.0`.
- Acceptance:
  - Ack before a blocking handler → pass (`go test ./slack -run TestAckBeforeBlockingHandler`; the 2nd envelope is also
    acked and handled while the 1st is still blocked)
  - Drop table (bot, message_changed, message_deleted, unknown user, wrong channel, for messages and clicks;
    `thread_broadcast` passes) → pass (`-run TestFilterAndAuthorize`)
  - Redelivery runs once, including after reopening the DB (message and click) → pass (`-run TestRedeliveryHandledOnce`)
  - Self-check fails when the channel isn't listed (2 pages); `Run` and `Post` refuse too → pass (`-run TestSelfCheck`)
  - A panicking handler doesn't stop later events → pass (`-run TestPanickingHandlerDoesNotStopLaterEvents`)
  - `go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...` → green; `go test -race ./slack` → green
- Deviations from brief:
  - slack-go's own go.mod forces (by MVS) `gorilla/websocket` 1.5.0→1.5.3 and `stretchr/testify` 1.11.1→1.12.1
    (indirect), plus `go.yaml.in/yaml/v3`; `go mod tidy` also dropped two unused indirect entries (go-spew, go-difflib).
    No other module changes.
- Follow-ups for backlog:

  - Schedule `PruneSlackEvents` (e.g. with the existing 24h prune job) in M3-14a/M3-15.
  - F10/F11 (redelivery and server `disconnect` refresh) are still unverified live; dedupe covers F10.
